FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF HISTORY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
(Accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC)
Dated: 22.07.2024
APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of One Guest Faculty to teach the subject
of History (Modern India/Modern Punjab) at Department of History, Panjab University, Chandigarh
for the Odd Semester (Academic session July, 2024 onwards):
Educational Qualifications:
As per UGC & P.U. Guidelines, M.A. in History is must.
(i) Good Academic record as defined by concerned University with Master’s degree with 55% marks
(50% marks in case of SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system
is followed) in History from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited
foreign university.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualification the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility
Test (NET) conducted by UGC or must fulfill the other UGC regulations for recruitment and
appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in the University/College/Institute.
Selection Process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of the Chairperson,
Department of History, Arts Block-II, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Last Date:
Applications to be submitted latest by 29th July, 2024 upto 4.00 pm in the office of Department
of History, Arts Block-II, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Interview:
The interview of shortlisted candidates for the post of One Guest Faculty will be held on 31st
July, 2024 from 3.00 p.m. onwards in the office of the Chairperson, Department of History,
Arts Block-II, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Affidavit :
Temporary/Guest/Part-Time Faculty should submit an affidavit to the effect that:
1. They are not employed elsewhere (Guest and Part-Time Faculty are exempted from this
clause).
2. There are no criminal proceedings, charge sheets, police cases, cases of moral misconduct
or court cases against them
The application form for the post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) is available at website
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php. The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium
of Rs.1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. You are advised to visit the
notice board of department website: history.puchd.ac.in for any further update.
*Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m.
*No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview
Sd/-
(Chairperson)
